title: Understanding Orthogonality
text: If a vector is orthogonal to the column space of a matrix, it means that the vector is perpendicular to every vector in that space. Think about what this implies for the projection of the vector onto the column space.

title: Projection Matrix
text: The projection matrix $H$ projects any vector onto the column space of $X$. If a vector is orthogonal to this space, what would its projection be?

title: Checking Orthogonality
text: What happens to a vector when it is projected onto a space it is orthogonal to?
